ownerStatement: Release Temp Save 0.1.1-experimental. I waive the static cycle bound and the hardware qualification of this build for this version, and keep 0.1.0's UI captures.
reason: 0.1.1 changes only how the reload reaches FUNC + CUE's seven refresh routines (a loop over their addresses) and how it marks the bank unsaved, so the USB package no longer repeats stock's instruction bytes (#1391). Temp Save works once per FUNC + YES or FUNC + NO press, in the UI task and outside the audio frame; 0.1.0's dearest event, a reload while playing, measured 640,923 executed instructions in the emulator against a 26,600,000 budget, and 0.1.1 adds at most 28. No static count was made. Every other qualification stays required. On the owner's word of 14 November 2026, the hardware qualification of this exact build is waived too: the owner's MKII ran the package only in a 20-second RAM trial (rolled back clean, no key pressed), and 0.1.0's UI captures are kept, since 0.1.1 draws nothing new.
